name: fxf_scene468_stairs
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/scene468_stairs_to_120.state (a teleport into the east tower's last flight with storyline 10): the ROM's own loader (--teleport 468 8 39 2, method jmp, 240 frames) from the Queen's chamber after Marle vanished (queen_vanishes, storyline 10) -- loc 1D4, Crono at tile (8,39) facing left above the flight's exit to the castle's main floor, where Lucca waits. USED since 2026-10-22 (tools/fixtures/rest.json makes saves/field_re/scene468_stairs_to_120.*; the owner's capture is retired): field-door-list-vs-logical-oracle was re-pinned on it, its load leg differing on 27 frames [f20-f46] where the capture's differed on 26 [f20-f45] (the port's atomic load against the cartridge's NMI-off load; docs/ROADMAP.md F17); the other checks pass on it unchanged.
